fact: In September 2021 a pilot with Banque El Amana opened a bank account for a refugee in Nouakchott, and UNHCR planned accounts for 100 urban refugees in the first quarter of 2022; refugees need a national ID number to register a SIM card.
title: Leveraging Digital ID and e-KYC for the Financial Inclusion of Forcibly Displaced Persons (FDPs): Risks and Opportunities
